correctness.rationale: The rotation-reduced T4 coordinates satisfy δ5=−sum(δ1...δ4), F=(7/5)sum_{i≤4} sinδ_i+sinδ5, so ∂iF=(7/5)cosδ_i−cosδ5. Let α=acos(5λ/7), β=acosλ; four disjoint root brackets of g1=4α+β−4π, g2=4α−β−2π, g3=2α+β−2π, g4=4α+β−2π give 2+2+8+2=14 patterns, with another binom(4,2)=6 at λ=1. Independent high-precision root/bracket verification finds λ≈−.9992823,−.8365816,−.6145814,+.4000670 with strict signs. Exact-rational interval verifier in package establishes the signs without floating-point assumptions. Hessian is −(7/5)diag(sin δ1...δ4)−sinδ5 11^T; definite cases and exact rank-one determinant inequality prove nonsingularity at all 20. A perfect Morse function on T4 has exactly sum of Betti numbers=16; therefore the function cannot be perfect Morse.
